victory.alt: If no Knight or Dragon: smash 5 Crystal tokens.

setup.pieces: 3 Goblin Tribe pieces on player board
setup.discs: Goblin and Strength discs near board; 1 Strength disc on Fangs

turn-summary.phase: Choose War Card (+1 Rage if at 0)
turn-summary.note: End after Activate Tribes. Shuffle entire War deck including chosen card when turn ends.

tribes.tribe: Strength disc +1 Strength. Special: Increase Rage by 1.
Extra Monster slot (2 Monsters). Special: Draw and assign 1 Monster.
More powerful Secrets. Special: Draw 1 Secrets card.

statistics.rule: Population = Goblin discs under Tribe piece.
Strength = Population + Strength discs (Fangs has permanent +1).
Max 4 Population per Tribe; overpopulation rules apply.
statistics.clarification: Strength discs never change Population, do not prevent disc placement, and do not cause overpopulation. The Fangs Strength disc cannot be lost or discarded.
The included Strength discs are a component limit. If all are in use, a card that needs a Strength disc has no effect until one becomes available.

rage-and-malaise.increase: When Tribe attacked/shot (Knight, Dragon); Dragon Hiss; Cave Soporific Spores; Thief Pickpocket/Backstab; Plunder; Fangs special; killing Thief.
rage-and-malaise.decrease: When Tribe successfully attacks another player; smash Crystal; spend to prevent overpopulation.
rage-and-malaise.malaise: Rage 0: −1 Strength all Tribes until Rage ≥ 1.
rage-and-malaise.clarification: A Tribe may still attack at Rage 0, applying the Malaise Strength penalty. Rage cannot decrease below 0.
Spending Rage to avoid placing Population discs requires having at least 1 Rage.

phase.rule: If Rage 0, increase to 1. Draw War cards equal to Rage. Choose one; discard others.
Add discs per War card. May skip adding discs to any Tribe by spending 1 Rage per Tribe affected.
phase.overpopulation: If Population would exceed 4: scatter one revealed Tribe; if none revealed, scatter hidden. Scattered Tribe need not be one that caused overpopulation.

phase.rule: Draw Monster cards per War card; assign to Tribes (Fangs 1, Eye 1, Bones 2). May replace existing. Discard unassigned.
Max Monsters assigned ≤ Bones Population. If Bones Population drops below assigned count, Monsters stay but new ones cannot be assigned until Population catches up.
Draw per War card. Hand limit 5 (face-up count).
Play Secrets any time on your turn; discard unless stated.
Each Tribe once per turn; any order; finish one before next.
phase.movement: Any number of tiles; Lit and Dark; not through walls. −1 Population per 2 Lit tiles exited same turn (remove disc on second).
phase.clarification: A Tribe can pass through the same Lit tile multiple times, but only the first exit from that Lit tile counts toward Population loss for that turn.
phase.actions: After movement: one action — Attack, Plunder, Explore, Special, Reveal, Hide. Tribe on board cannot move. 0 Population: no actions. Revealed Tribes only for most actions except Reveal/Hide as stated.

action.targets: Knight, Thief, Dragon (Ash Dragon Variant only), smash Crystal with two Tribes
action.knight: Strength > Knight Strength to enter. Attack: Knight −1 Health, Tribe scatters, Rage −1. Knight 0: you win.
action.thief: Always enter. Perception > Thief Stealth to attack; Thief killed; Rage −1; Tribe does not scatter; draw Secrets or gain Rage per Loot Drop.
action.dragon: Strength > Dragon Armor to enter; attack resolves per Goblins rules with Ash Dragon if applicable.
action.crystal: Two Tribes each Strength ≥ 3; each uses Attack on Crystal before turn ends. Smash: give Crystal to Knight (or keep on board if no Knight); both Tribes scatter; Rage −1.
action.clarification: If a combined Crystal attack cannot succeed, neither part of the attack happens: no Rage is lost and neither Tribe scatters for that failed attempt.
action.disputed: When entering a tile with multiple opposing pieces, Scholar states the Goblins must be strong enough to overcome the relevant defenses to enter. Treat this as a check against every opposing piece that would block entry unless a scenario-specific rule says otherwise.

action.treasure: Rage +1; return token to Cave supply.
action.dragon-gem: Roll die; center: Tribe scatters. Else: Rage +1. Return Gem to Dragon. May plunder from Dragon if no Gems on map and Strength > Armor.

action.rule: On Dark tile: choose adjacent open space; Cave places Cave tile Dark up (or you draw); place Tribe on that tile.
Move hidden Tribe from board to Dark tile with Tribe symbol; or open space adjacent to any tile (lurking).
action.clarification: A Tribe cannot Reveal on a tile with another player's piece, even if that piece would not prompt an attack. A Tribe may Reveal on a tile with another Tribe or a Treasure token. A Tribe with 0 Population cannot Reveal.
action.lurking: Still hidden. Later: move to adjacent tile only OR Hide; no action after lurk move. Tile placed under lurking Tribe → revealed.
action.clarification: A lurking Tribe remains hidden and cannot be directly attacked, but it may attack when the Knight encounters an Ambush.

action.rule: Return Tribe piece to player board. Hidden Tribes not targeted except Ambush tile/Event when Knight reveals.

special-actions.note: Hidden Tribe cannot use special action.

scatter.effect: Tribe to board; Population −2; discard Monster (if Bones had 2 Monsters, discard one of choice)

dragon-gems-on-map.rule: Each Gem on map provides its symbol for your powers (Dragon chapter).
